name: Anything as Markdown
description: Allows any file extension to be registered as Markdown (e.g. mdx, svx, rmd, qmd, mdown, mkdn, mkd, mdwn, mdtxt, mdtext, myst, markua). User-configurable in settings. Experimental setting to allow Obsidian-indexing of files (not yet search indexing).
author: sec-ml
